attributes.action: Ofcom to implement "protocols” to hold platforms responsible for misinformation
attributes.background: “The government must do more to stop the spread of misinformation online. The Online Safety Act is woefully inadequate and riddled with regulatory gaps which must be amended to deal with misinformation & AI abuse on social media platforms.  Owners of these platforms must be held accountable.

rejection.details:
The following petition calls for a similar action: 

Regulate Social Media Platforms as News Publishers to Prevent Misinformation
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/769402
